name: Vedic Date Formatter
description: Adds a custom PHP date-format character that renders the current muhūrta (48-minute Vedic time division) in any Drupal date format.
project_description:
Vedic Date Formatter provides a customizable PHP date format character that provides the muhūrta accounting for sunrise and timezone. More information on muhūrtas here, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhurta .

 Features 
 On the configuration page set the replacement character, defaults to 'q', and override any of the muhūrta names.

Use the muhūrta replacement character in custom date format strings.
